headline: Deficit: negotiations with Europe still open to keep defense and energy off the books
summary: Italy is holding firm on its deficit while negotiations with Europe continue over keeping defence and energy spending off the books. The government hopes to bring the deficit below 3% by the end of the year.
why: Italy's deficit and debt path under EU fiscal rules shape the borrowing costs of its government bonds and the room for public spending.
